title: A method to reproduce pH and Eh environmental changes due to sediment resuspension
author: Vicente, Trevisan, et al.
materials: Before the experiment performing all pieces of equipment were washed and put on an acid solution (HCl 3%) for three days, after that the equipment was dried in a drying oven. The multiparameter Hanna® probe was calibrated for pH and Eh with standard calibration solutions.•Experiment Laboratory Apparatus Required•Polypropylene Bottles (1 Liter)•Plastic Bottles (10 Liters)•Becker (0,5 Liter)•Plastic Spatula•Centrifuge Tubes (60 mL)•Syringe (50 mL)•Plastic hose (3 mm diameter)•Glove bag•He Gas Cylinder•Orbital shaker•Centrifuge (at least 3000 rpm)•HNO3 (concentrated)•Automatic Pipette•Milli-Q water•Analytical Balance
It is important to note, the number of centrifuge tubes should be related to the metal extraction method chosen and the polypropylene bottles and syringes with the number of samples.

steps.title: Clean and calibrate equipment
steps.instruction: Wash all laboratory equipment, soak it in 3 % HCl solution for three days, dry the equipment in a drying oven, and calibrate the Hanna® multiparameter probe for pH and Eh using the standard calibration solutions.

substeps.instruction: Wash all pieces of equipment.
Immerse equipment in 3 % HCl acid solution for three days.
Dry the equipment in a drying oven.
Calibrate the Hanna® multiparameter probe for pH and Eh with standard calibration solutions.

steps.title: Purge water of dissolved oxygen
steps.instruction: Connect a 3 mm plastic hose to a helium cylinder, bubble helium through the collected water for at least 30 min while monitoring Eh and pH with the electronic probe.

substeps.instruction: Attach the plastic hose to the He gas cylinder.
Bubble He through the water for ≥30 min.
Continuously monitor Eh and pH with the probe during the purge.

steps.title: Prepare sediment‑water slurries
steps.instruction: Using a 1 : 2.5 sediment‑to‑water ratio, place 200 g of sediment into polypropylene bottles, add 0.5 L He‑purged water, create an anoxic glove‑bag environment with He, seal the bottles, and incubate them in a dark room for 15 days.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 200 g of sediment on an analytical balance.
Transfer the sediment into polypropylene bottles with a plastic spatula.
Place the bottles, a 0.5 L beaker containing the He‑purged water, and the multiparameter probe inside an empty glove bag.
Seal the glove bag and fill it with He gas to establish an anoxic atmosphere.
Fill each bottle with the He‑purged water and tightly close the caps.
Incubate the sealed bottles in a dark room for 15 days.

steps.title: Collect initial slurry sample (T0)
steps.instruction: After the 15‑day incubation, open the bottles inside the He‑filled glove box, manually agitate the slurry, and draw a sample with a syringe attached to a plastic hose, labeling it as T0.

substeps.instruction: Open the bottles inside the He‑filled glove box.
Vigorously agitate the slurry manually.
Draw the slurry using a syringe connected to a plastic hose.
Label this first sample as T0.

steps.title: Perform oxidation sampling series
steps.instruction: Place the bottles on an orbital shaker at 60 rpm, and collect slurry samples after 10 min (T1), 120 min (T2), 240 min (T3), and 720 min (T4), recording Eh and pH at each time point.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the bottles from the glove bag to an orbital shaker set to 60 rpm.
After 10 min of shaking, collect a slurry sample (T1) and record Eh and pH.
After 120 min of shaking, collect a slurry sample (T2) and record Eh and pH.
After 240 min of shaking, collect a slurry sample (T3) and record Eh and pH.
After 720 min of shaking, collect a slurry sample (T4) and record Eh and pH.

steps.title: Centrifuge and process slurry samples
steps.instruction: Transfer each collected slurry into 60 mL centrifuge tubes, centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 20 min, separate supernatant from particulate matter, lyophilize the particulate fraction for later metal extraction, and use Milli‑Q water as a blank.

substeps.instruction: Place each slurry sample into a 60 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the tubes for 20 min at 3000 rpm.
Separate the supernatant from the particulate matter.
Lyophilize the particulate matter for subsequent trace‑metal extraction.
Prepare a Milli‑Q water blank for the experiment.
